editionLabel: English summary of Schmidt Spiele German rules, standard article 40505
houseFallback: If the criterion cannot select one player, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Each player receives a mouse and puts it on the start field.
After the youngest player begins, players take turns rolling the die. The German rulebook does not specify clockwise or counterclockwise order.
The youngest-player instruction selects the initial starter. No separate later-round starter or alternative mode is supplied.
This answer summarizes the German page of the standard article 40505 manual for two to six players. The compact article 51405 edition is a separate source and is not covered by this answer.
